supervisors.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore, by licence, for digital payment token service providers

pairs.name: Payments and MSBs in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for payments and MSBs in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore, for payment service providers, money-changers included

pairs.name: Banks and financial institutions in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for banks and financial institutions in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore

pairs.name: Funds and corporate service providers in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for funds and corporate service providers in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore, for capital markets intermediaries and licensed trust companies; the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority, for corporate service providers, which register with it

pairs.name: Gold, precious metals and stones in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for gold, precious metals and stones in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Ministry of Law, for dealers in precious stones, precious metals or precious products, which register with its Registrar of Regulated Dealers

pairs.name: Gaming in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for gaming in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Gambling Regulatory Authority, for casinos

pairs.name: Real estate and DNFBPs in Singapore
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for real estate and DNFBPs in Singapore?

supervisors.text: The Council for Estate Agencies, for estate agents and real estate salespersons; the Urban Redevelopment Authority, for real estate developers; the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority, for corporate service providers

pairs.name: Virtual assets and crypto in Hong Kong
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for virtual assets and crypto in Hong Kong?

supervisors.text: The Securities and Futures Commission, by licence

pairs.name: Payments and MSBs in Hong Kong
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for payments and MSBs in Hong Kong?

supervisors.text: The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, for remittance agents and money changers

pairs.name: Banks and financial institutions in Hong Kong
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for banks and financial institutions in Hong Kong?

supervisors.text: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority

pairs.name: Funds and corporate service providers in Hong Kong
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for funds and corporate service providers in Hong Kong?

supervisors.text: The Securities and Futures Commission, for licensed corporations; the Companies Registry, for trust or company service providers

pairs.name: Real estate and DNFBPs in Hong Kong
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for real estate and DNFBPs in Hong Kong?

supervisors.text: The Estate Agents Authority, for estate agents; the Law Society of Hong Kong, for legal professionals; the Companies Registry, for trust or company service providers

pairs.name: Virtual assets and crypto in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for virtual assets and crypto in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, for digital currency exchanges and other virtual asset service providers

pairs.name: Payments and MSBs in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for payments and MSBs in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, for remittance service providers

pairs.name: Banks and financial institutions in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for banks and financial institutions in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre

pairs.name: Funds and corporate service providers in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for funds and corporate service providers in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, for trust and company service providers, for the services the Act lists, since 1 July 2026

pairs.name: Gold, precious metals and stones in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for gold, precious metals and stones in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, for bullion dealers, and since 1 July 2026 for dealers in precious metals, stones and products, for the services the Act lists

pairs.name: Gaming in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for gaming in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, for casinos, bookmakers and betting agencies, and pubs and clubs with gaming machines

pairs.name: Real estate and DNFBPs in Australia
pairs.question: Who is the AML/CFT supervisor for real estate and DNFBPs in Australia?

supervisors.text: AUSTRAC, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre, since 1 July 2026, for real estate professionals, lawyers, conveyancers, accountants and trust and company service providers, for the services the Act lists
